messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — pre-shift note. I'm taking primary for the 03:00-07:00 window while we run the infra rolling upgrade. Planner: warmstart all critical pools before traffic shift. Expect transient tail latency for 10-15m after swap.
Priya Patel: ack. which pools are we warming? any known kv-cache evictions to watch?
Alex Chen: primary pools: inference-pool-a, inference-pool-b. kv-cache: we'll force prefix warmcache for common prefixes (chat.*, embed.*). If you see 503s, fallback route is redwood-fallback-small.
Marco Ruiz: noted. I added a quick checklist in the runbook, link below. Also enabling autoscaling drain hook so we don't overcommit.
Marco Ruiz: runbook: https://intranet.redwood.com/runbooks/infra/warmstart-swap (quicklinks section)
Jamie L: Incident bot preflight simulated alert triggered when I ran the smoke script — normal. leaving note in the thread.
incident-bot: [TEST ALERT] smoke-test: latency spike observed for inference-pool-b — 5xx ratio rose to 0.9% during test. No external paging.
Priya Patel: good — that's the expected behavior for the warm cache step. Quick remediation pointers if spike persists: 1) check pool health: `rctl pool status inference-pool-b` 2) hand-evict slow nodes: `rctl node evict <node-id>` 3) switch routing to redwood-fallback-small: update policy in console or `api route set --route inference --variant fallback-small`
Alex Chen: adding short commands below to the thread for oncall copy-paste:
```
# check pool health
rctl pool status inference-pool-b
# tail logs for 5xx
kubectl logs -n inference deploy/inference-pool-b --tail=200 | grep -E "5.."
# evict node
rctl node evict i-0abc1234
# route fallback (CLI)
api route set --route inference --variant redwood-fallback-small
```
Marco Ruiz: If we get persistent KV cache thrash, enable prefix caching snapshot restore from s3 snapshot (this will prime the KV cache faster). Command: `kvtool restore --snapshot s3://redwood-cache-snapshots/prefix-warm-2026-03-15`
Jamie L: tagging escalation matrix: if customer-facing latency > 1s p95 for >10m or error-rate >1% -> page oncall primary (pager duty) and notify product-sse. :rotating_light:
Priya Patel: coverage gap note — Marco is OOO 04:00-05:00; Alex you are primary but if you need handoff ping Jamie who is secondary. I'll monitor metrics from the consoles.
Alex Chen: got it. handoff-plan: 03:50 quick sync in #eng-oncall, 04:00 swap start, 04:15 check tails and run smoke-scenarios. If anything unexpected, escalate to oncall manager @Priya.
incident-bot: [AUTO] deploy-bot: rolling upgrade started on inference-pool-a (deploy/infra-v2.4.1) — tracking at https://deploys.redwood.com/deploys/infra-v2.4.1
Marco Ruiz: small reminder: if we need immediate rollback, the fastest path is block traffic with `api route set --route inference --variant legacy` then revert deploy in console (rollback button).
Alex Chen: quick checklist summary:
- Preflight: warmstart snapshot restore for kv-cache (if scheduled)
- During swap: monitor p95, error-rate, KV miss-rate, and paging thresholds
- Remediations: evict bad nodes, route to fallback variant, rolling rollback if necessary
- Communication: update this thread and call bridge if customer-impacting (bridge # -> `+1` if paging)
Jamie L: I'm leaving a short debug snippet people can use to evaluate KV miss-rate quickly:
```
# KV miss-rate from metrics API
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.com/api/query?metric=kv_cache_miss_rate&pool=inference-pool-b&window=5m" | jq .value
```
Priya Patel: also adding runbook anchor links (direct anchors):
- Warmstart & KV cache: https://intranet.redwood.com/runbooks/infra/warmstart-swap#kv-cache-priming
- Fallback routing: https://intranet.redwood.com/runbooks/infra/warmstart-swap#fallback-routing
- Evict & Replace nodes: https://intranet.redwood.com/runbooks/infra/node-eviction
Alex Chen: thanks — I'm going to start the swap in ~5. If anything pages, call me and drop a note here. :thumbsup:
Jamie L: 👍 I'll be watching dashboards and can take over primary if you need to jump to the bridge.
incident-bot: [AUTO-INFO] smoke-test complete — transient spike observed during warm cache step, metrics within expected window. No customer-impact.
Alex Chen: closing the handoff prep. Follow-up: I'll post a short post-mortem if we see any regression tomorrow.
Priya Patel: copy. enjoy the warm coffee window. :coffee:
